decoder.name: D1 (lcr.decoder.solve_batch)
decoder.token_statistics: n_t, label counts y_t (exact), teacher sums s_t accumulated from zeros over member fine cells in increasing fine index (= qpc token_tables = lcr.decoder.token_stats, bitwise); fallback/empty tokens (n_t = 0) carry no loss and the pinned D0 vector at release

fitting_quantities.rows: OSF_DEFENSE_FIT (tr), deployed fine-cell routing of the frozen teacher
fitting_quantities.B_i: (1/N) sum_t sum_k y_t[k] * sum_j (q_t[j] - [j=k])^2 (source multiclass Brier)
fitting_quantities.I_i: plug-in I(SEX; full token of recipient i), exact integer tables, n log n lookup, natural log
fitting_quantities.exact_state_value: sum of the sorted nonzero per-token (per-cell) contributions (path/label independent)
fitting_quantities.incremental: candidate deltas by vectorised difference formulas from per-token sufficient statistics (n_t, y_t, s_t, SEX counts) and the pair count table; accepted moves re-checked on exact state values and reverted if the exact check fails

budgets.U: continuous U teacher probabilities on the same fitting rows, dpc per_row conventions
budgets.local_cap: I_i <= I_i(C-TASK) of the same seed (exact record bits, refs['I_ctask'])
budgets.decision_preservation: structural: tokens never cross predicted classes; decoder certifies strict argmax = class; release_arrays_d1 re-checks every row

state_caps.rule: upper bounds; tokens are never created; empty tokens are removed

objectives.C-TASK: T (per recipient L_i + 0.5 B_i); no SEX enters the search; budgets recorded, not enforced
objectives.W-LOCAL: T + lam (I1 + I2)/2 (per recipient L_i + 0.5 B_i + lam I_i / 2); no hard budget
objectives.W-SEQ-12/21: T + lam Phi; sequential; no hard budget
objectives.W-JOINT: T + lam Phi; joint single moves; no hard budget
objectives.K-LOCAL: min I_i per recipient s.t. its own budgets and local cap
objectives.K-SEQ-12/21: Phi; stage 1 only the first recipient's budgets + cap (CLASS-ONLY partner never required feasible, never a constant); stage 2 the second's; FINAL must satisfy both
objectives.K-JOINT-SINGLE: Phi s.t. both budgets + both local caps; single-recipient moves

neighbourhood.proposal: move ONE WHOLE fine cell to an existing alive token of its predicted class (tokens never created; a move may empty its source token, which is then removed)
neighbourhood.targets_per_cell: union of the 4 nearest targets by KL(fine-cell mean teacher prob || target's current released q) and the 4 targets with the best exact objective change (C-TASK: task objective, no SEX), deduplicated
neighbourhood.ties: lexicographic (value, target canonical index = lowest member fine index)
neighbourhood.exact_objective_change_evaluated_for: every alive same-class target (counted as proposal evaluations)
neighbourhood.accept: best strictly improving (delta < -1e-12) feasible target of the neighbourhood; ties within 1e-12 -> lowest canonical target; applied at once; exact re-check (new exact objective < old, constraints of every enforced recipient on exact values) else reverted
neighbourhood.ordering: one deterministic ordering per start: recipients 1 then 2 (local: each alone; seq: one per stage), fine cells in increasing index; cells with no fitting rows or in single-token classes have no proposal
neighbourhood.sweep_restart: each sweep restarts from the coherent accepted state (memo refreshed)
neighbourhood.stop: a sweep with no accepted single or paired move ('no_change_sweep'), the sweep cap ('sweep_cap') or the unit's proposal-evaluation share ('eval_ceiling')
neighbourhood.feasibility_screen: constrained arms: neighbourhood candidates are screened on the moved recipient's own budgets and local cap (exact current value + delta, margins above); improving-but-infeasible candidates are counted as rejected_by_budget

pair_step.pool: every neighbourhood candidate of every fine cell of the recipient at the post-sweep state that satisfies that recipient's own budgets and local cap (non-improving included)
pair_step.retain: 4 by exact one-sided Phi change, then 4 more (not already retained) by exact task-loss change L_i + 0.5 B_i; ties (value, fine cell, target canonical index)
pair_step.evaluate: Cartesian product (8 x 8) atomically: both moves applied, joint table and both decoders recomputed, every constraint re-checked on exact values
pair_step.accept: best feasible strict Phi improvement (< -1e-12); ties first in (i, j) order

starts_notes.lam_placeholder: W-JOINT witnesses are at the SAME lambda as the unit (l0.01 shown)
starts_notes.maps: each start/witness is a policy.json map; only its cell->token map is used; D1 recomputed
starts_notes.local: C-TASK starts from source FINE-TASK; K-LOCAL / W-LOCAL from C-TASK
starts_notes.seq: C-TASK + the six source SEQ-ab maps; per start: stage 1 from the start's first-recipient map with the partner at CLASS-ONLY, stage 2 from the start's second-recipient map with the frozen first map
starts_notes.joint: every witness that satisfies all constraints (K- arms; W-JOINT: all) is a candidate UNCHANGED and is refined; an infeasible witness is recorded EXCLUDED_INFEASIBLE_WITNESS and is never eligible by its name
starts_notes.infeasible_start: local/seq: a start infeasible for the stage's enforced constraints is not refined (INFEASIBLE_START, ineligible); no restoration phase
starts_notes.winner: lowest exact objective among eligible candidates; ties: registered order, refined before unchanged; none eligible -> status INFEASIBLE (descriptive release of the first candidate)

equal_work.definition: proposal evaluation = one exact objective change of one (cell, target) candidate, or one atomic pair; pair-pool screening counts
equal_work.allocation: joint: ceiling / #starts per start; seq: ceiling / (2 #starts) per stage per start; local: ceiling / (2 #starts) per recipient
equal_work.same_for: every arm (K-JOINT-SINGLE = K-JOINT-PAIR = K-SEQ-12 = K-SEQ-21 = 8e6 total)
equal_work.recorded: actual evaluations, solves, memo hits/misses and CPU per start and per unit

cache.rule: memo of decoder solves per (recipient, class, fine cell, slot); an entry is reused only if its stored (n_t, y_t, s_t) are BITWISE equal to the freshly folded statistics (exact sufficient-statistic key, -0.0 impossible for sums of nonnegative values); never reused across different label counts or teacher sums
cache.batch: lcr.decoder.solve_batch (rows independent and bitwise equal to solve_token)

receipts: every accepted move; rejected_by_budget counts (L, B, I); rejected_on_exact_recheck
sweeps and stop reasons per stage/start
objective and constraint values of every start, of every refined candidate and of the winner
coherent final recomputation from the deployed release (row-level L, B; mi_plugin I, I12) with state-vs-deployed parity
budget slack, local-cap slack, actual token counts per class
proposal counts, solves, memo hits, CPU per start and unit
not_claimed: convexity of the discrete program (only the fixed-token decoder is convex)
